entities.name: Rotavirus A VP3
observations: 768-aa query has 88.2% identity and 100.0% query coverage to reviewed Rotavirus A VP3 Q6WNV6.
Curated homolog annotation describes multifunctional viral mRNA-capping enzyme with guanylyltransferase, N7-methyltransferase, and 2′-5′ oligoadenylate phosphodiesterase activities.

entities.name: RNA cap guanylylation
observations: Adds GMP from GTP to the 5′ diphosphate end of mRNA, forming a 5′-5′ triphosphate-linked cap and diphosphate.

entities.name: RNA cap N7 methylation
observations: Transfers a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to guanosine N7 of the RNA cap, producing S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

entities.name: 2-5A phosphodiesterase
observations: Hydrolyzes 5′-triphosphoadenylyl-(2′→5′)-adenylyl-(2′→5′)-adenosine to AMP and ATP, opposing OAS-produced 2-5A signaling.
The reviewed homolog annotation links this activity to preventing RNase L activation.
